title: A Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Formoterol Fumarate 20 Mcg/0.5 mL in the Treatment of Patients With COPD
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and efficacy of the investigational drug in comparison with a placebo.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Medical diagnosis of COPD
* Current or prior history of cigarette smoking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical diagnosis of asthma
* Chest X-ray diagnostic of significant disease other than COPD
* Significant condition or disease other than COPD
